picks.excerpt: Figma now lets designers author custom Skills for the Figma agent directly inside the product, and publish them to the Community. The post highlights ten featured skills spanning visual effects, design documentation and usability-testing workflows.
picks.rationale: Designers can now author and publish their own agent Skills — the fastest route from 'AI helps sometimes' to a repeatable, team-shared workflow.

picks.excerpt: PTC's new Onshape FeatureScript MCP Server lets users describe a desired CAD feature in natural language and have AI build and refine the custom tool. It targets repeated modelling bottlenecks by turning them into bespoke buttons.
picks.rationale: Natural language now produces a reusable CAD feature, not just geometry — a modelling bottleneck becomes a custom button you keep.

picks.excerpt: New EU guidelines require clearly labelling AI-generated content for anyone serving EU citizens, effective August 2, 2026. The rules cover deepfakes, chatbots, AI-written text and biometric tools — pushing designers to build disclosure into the UI itself.
picks.rationale: A dated compliance rule that lands in the UI layer — disclosure of AI content becomes a component and copy decision, not a legal footnote.

picks.excerpt: Marmoset shipped Toolbag 5.03, a free update to its real-time rendering and look-dev tool. It adds Text and Scatter Layers for texturing, IES light profiles with physical light units, and 3Dconnexion SpaceMouse support.
picks.rationale: Free point release with real look-dev gains — Text/Scatter texturing layers and IES physical lighting change how product renders get lit tomorrow.

picks.excerpt: James C. Kane built an immersive gel, sand and water simulation running in the browser on Apple Vision Pro using WebXR, WebGPU and Three.js. He claims it's the first real-time sim of its kind delivered entirely through the web on the headset.
picks.rationale: Proof that a real-time immersive sim ships through a URL — WebXR + WebGPU removes the app-store step from spatial prototyping.
